task.title: Resolve a schema mismatch
task.shortdesc: Handle unsupported schema channel, ESR/Release mismatch, or schema-dependent setting without forcing hidden data changes.

prereq.p: A visible BPM status, validation message, browser warning, or failed action indicates that the current workflow cannot safely continue.

context.p: Schema mismatch usually means a setting exists in one Firefox channel but is unavailable, deprecated, or shaped differently in the selected channel.

step.cmd: Confirm whether the profile targets ESR 115.39, ESR 140.13, ESR 153.0, or Release 153.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Identify the setting that is unavailable, unsupported, deprecated, or schema-dependent in that channel.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Choose whether to switch the schema channel or remove/change the affected setting for the intended Firefox target.

info.p: For a channel move, choose a distinct current artifact and request a fresh read-only preview. Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Revalidate and review export readiness after the channel or setting decision.

info.note: A blocked, stale, invalid, or failed preview/apply leaves the profile unchanged. Resolve the visible blocker or choose another target, then request a new preview; do not change profile data outside the application.

result.p: The profile targets the intended Firefox channel and no longer hides a schema-dependent mismatch.

postreq.p: If the error repeats, stop the workflow and contact support with the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current page.
